claims: TD-CDFT in 3D coordinate space tracks real-time non-linear evolution of single-particle Dirac spinors under PC-PK1 without spatial symmetry restrictions.
Chiral precession manifests as closed elliptic trajectories of (theta_J, phi_J) on the total energy surface around the tilted axis in the (s-l) plane.

Fourier spectral analysis of theta_J(t) and phi_J(t) oscillations directly extracts the chiral partner band excitation energy E*(I) in the harmonic limit without phenomenological rotor parameter tuning.

At critical spin I=31/2h in 135Nd, the energy surface undergoes supercritical pitchfork bifurcation into twin degenerate chiral minima separated by a barrier at phi_J=0, demonstrating static chirality below the barrier and quantum tunneling across the barrier.
TD-CDFT combined with static 3DTAC-CDFT self-consistently reproduces both positive- and negative-parity chiral doublet bands in 135Nd without any adjustable parameters beyond PC-PK1.
